posts.text: Day one of the countdown. Ostrand's highway opening, a 50,000 crowd for Arden, and two debate answers that both dodged the costings. Before I cheer or groan, I want the numbers from both camps. Anyone have the inflation series and the jobs estimate?

Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.
Debate night. Ostrand on inflation, Arden on 200k jobs. Both got pressed on costings. Anyone actually read the numbers before deciding, or just the clips?

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my diesel cost more again this month and nobody on VBC asked why. Watching the debate tonight, Arden at least got asked about costings. Let's see if he answers.

Long shift, but caught the debate on the break room TV. Arden talked about 200k jobs, Ostrand defended her inflation numbers. Both got grilled on costings, which I'd like to see more of. Staffing is the thing I'll be watching for. Anyone else catch it?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Read the VeriCheck piece on Arden's plan. VAT doubling: false. The 40% fuel number comes from a peak month. Gap of ~2% of GDP is still a real question though. Both camps should answer it, not just repeat their clips.
Civic Front says fuel is up 40% under Ostrand. My diesel bill this month says they're not wrong. Ask Arden how he'd bring it down, not just who to blame. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 and I'm still thinking about the debate. Arden's 200k jobs needs a real costing, same as Ostrand's inflation claims. Staffing numbers in hospitals are what I'll be watching for. Anyone else checking the figures before they vote?

Read the VeriCheck breakdown on Arden's plan. VAT doubling: false. The '40% fuel' figure: real, but it's a peak month, not a trend. And economists still see a gap of about 2% of GDP. Both camps should answer that number directly.
Careful with this one. A party page saying 'DOUBLE VAT' and 'share before they delete it' is a red flag. Check the actual plan text before passing it on. Measure twice.
posts.orig_text: Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

posts.text: Day 2, 11 to go. VeriCheck put out a check today: Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure uses a peak month. They also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the check before you share the clip. Both camps should show their workings.
Day 2 and I'm already sick of the Kessa traffic. Ostrand's highway better be worth it lol. Still not sure who I'm backing after that debate, but Mara at least had numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and both camps are still promising the moon. Ostrand has her highway, Arden has his 200k jobs, and somehow I'm the one expected to do the math. Someone please show me the costings before I vote with vibes.

Played the VBC clip of the 'Arden recording' twice. No source, no date, no chain of custody. Until someone shows where it came from, I'm treating it like a rumour, not news. Anyone got the original file?

Day 3. Saw that 'leaked audio' forward going round the WhatsApp groups, and then VBC playing the clip with 'questions raised'. I'm not sharing it, and I'm not dismissing it either. Nurse's rule: don't pass on something until you've checked the chart. Waiting for VeriCheck and the Civic Front's response before I believe either side.

Day 3, 10 to go. VBC aired a clip 'questioning' a recording of Mr Arden. The Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing, check whether anyone has verified the file's source and metadata. Who has actually authenticated it? Reserve judgment until we know.

Day 3. I've now watched that VBC clip twice. It's a recording with no provenance: no date, no source, no chain of custody. 'Questions raised' is not evidence. Before anyone shares it, ask who made it and when. Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Show me the forensics, not the adjectives.

Day 3 countdown. Saw that 'leaked audio' going round the WhatsApp groups. VBC says questions raised, Civic Front says it's fake. Before forwarding ANYTHING this close to the vote, I'm waiting for an actual check. Not sharing it til someone who knows audio tells us it's real. #VeloriaVotes
Haven't seen a single outlet check the VBC clip yet. Who recorded it, when, and where's the original file? Until someone answers that, I'm treating it as unverified, same as any other clip.

Got the WhatsApp audio about Arden 'paying the commission'. Civic Front says it's an AI fake, VBC says 'questions raised'. Neither of those tells me if it's real. Hold off on forwarding till someone checks it. Fuel is still killing me though.

Day 3. A leaked 'audio' forwarded 100 times, and VBC says 'questions raised' about a clip the Civic Front calls fake. Before I share anything, I want the original file and a fact-check. Measure twice, cut once. Who verified this?

Day 4, 9 to go. Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Before sharing: which document or official record backs that up? Same rule as the 'leaked audio': no source, no share. Check the claim first.

Day 4. Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a tie with a lot of noise. Traffic in Kessa is still the worst part of my day lol. Same question as always: who's showing their costings? #VeloriaVotes

Kito poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the margin of error, so it's a coin flip. Anyone who says it's over is guessing. Still want Arden to explain his fuel plan, not just blame Mara.

Day 4, 9 to go. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Undecideds, that's you and me. Read the costings, not the clips. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Kito's new poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat with a lot of people still unsure. Before this goes round the groups, check who ran it and how it was weighted. Anyone have the full methodology?

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on the deputy minister's road funds is a claim, not yet a finding. The ministry says fabricated. Before this travels further: has anyone seen the actual documents, or only the paper's description of them? Show the paper trail from both sides. Poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That is a dead heat, so the undecideds decide this. Who is checking the docume

Day 4. Ledger says a deputy minister's relative got road contracts; ministry says fabricated. Who has the documents and can they be checked? Same standard for both sides. Not sharing until someone shows the paperwork.

Day 4, 9 to go. VBC is still pushing the 'leaked audio' and nobody has shown the original file, date, or source yet. Patriots Daily is running 'foreign passport' on Arden's running mate with no link to a document. Before anything gets shared, where's the paperwork? Show me the file, the passport, or it's just vibes. Also Ostrand 46 / Arden 44 with ±3 margin = basically tied, so nobody gets to be s

Day 5, 8 to go. Saw the 'join as a community ambassador' thing going round: 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity? That's paying people to vote, not a campaign. Who's behind the bot link? Also the commission is publishing forms on VeloResults, so anyone can check the real numbers. Check before you join anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Still no original file for the 'leaked audio', no passport for the running mate, and the Ledger's documents are 'described' not shown. Dead heat in the polls. Show the paperwork from BOTH sides or it's just vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The commission is publishing how results get transmitted: scanned polling-station forms uploaded to VeloResults, and observers invited to a system test. That's the kind of checkable process I want. Anyone going to the test? Show the forms, not the rumours.

Day 5, 8 to go. Two things to sit with: a WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote? Don't sign up. And the commission is inviting observers to test VeloResults. Good. Go look at the system, don't just take anyone's word. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. The commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good: go check the process yourself before trusting any 'the count is rigged' clip. Show the upload trail, not the vibes.

Day 5, 8 to go. Two tags trending, both from accounts made this month posting near-identical text. Before you share #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, who's behind them? Also: the VeloResults upload procedure is public and observers can test it. Read that, not the hashtags.

Day 5. The thing I keep coming back to: the commission is publishing how results get uploaded to VeloResults and inviting observers to test it. Good. That's checkable. Before I believe any 'leaked' clip or 'ambassador' sign-up bonus, I'm going to read the actual procedure. Nurse's rule: check the chart.

Day 5. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot link going round: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? That's paying people to vote, not a campaign. Anyone who wants to help, do it openly. Also the commission's VeloResults test is open to observers, worth showing up. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Don't forward it. Check the IECV site or call your local office first. If it's real, it'll be published there. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. A WhatsApp forward says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels or shares it, check the official IECV notice and the commission's own site. If it's real, it'll be published there. Don't rely on the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. A 'OFFICIAL LETTER' forwarded 100 times says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Check the IECV site or call them before you believe a WhatsApp PDF. Measure twice, cut once. Where's the original?

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round, her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, one clip proves nothing either way. Same rule for everything this week: check the original footage and the context before reacting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Maybe. Either way, the real question is still the costings, not the clip. Show me the policy, Mara. Show me the paperwork, Tomas. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, it's a gaffe, not a policy. Can we get back to the costings? Both sides, same standard. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town's name is a slip, and her team says so. Fine. Mispronunciations are cheap. Costings aren't. Still waiting for either camp to answer the ~2% of GDP gap directly. Watch the numbers, not the viral moments. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Three things today: a 'Valdoria Today' claim that NGOs are funding Arden (who's the source?), a WhatsApp 'IECV letter' moving 212 Northern polling stations (check the IECV site before you believe it), and a viral Ostrand slip that her team calls a slip. Check the letter first, it could send people to the wrong place. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Reminder: the IECV's own notices and VeloResults are where to check polling-station changes, the 212-station 'letter' included. Nothing from forwards. Quiet week, read the official sources. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the Ostrand 'danger to our children' clip is trending at the last minute. Zuri K can endorse whoever she wants. Show me Arden's actual platform on childcare costs and I'll listen. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so this is my last word on the noise. The pattern all week: viral clips, forwarded PDFs, 'leaks' with no origin. Each time I asked for the original file or document, and none came. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3: a dead heat. If you're undecided, check the costings and the IECV site, not the forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is a voter-suppression line, full stop. Your vote is yours to cast. Go to your polling station, check the IECV notice, and bring your ID. Don't let anyone tell you the runoff makes today pointless. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more arguing about clips for a while. Still nobody has shown the original file for the 'leaked audio', and the Ostrand singer video is just an endorsement with no costings. Read the policy, not the reactions. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. That 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note going round WhatsApp? Don't forward it. Nobody legit tells you to skip voting. Vote, then check VeloResults. Same rule as always: show me the source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the WhatsApp 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note from Arden's name is worth a double-check. Official word is the IECV page, not a forwarded voice note. Nurse's rule: check the chart before you pass it on. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so for once the timeline can rest. Forwarded voice note telling people to stay home tomorrow 'we have it covered'? Nope. Vote, don't stay home. Check the IECV site before believing any WhatsApp 'official' letter. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Polls are open! If your ID kit failed in the North, the law lets you use the printed register, so don't turn back. Check the IECV site for any notices, and don't believe the 'stuffed ballot box' photo until we see the original source. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. If your voter-ID kit failed in the North, the printed register is legal. Check the IECV site for your station, bring your ID, vote. Don't trust any WhatsApp 'official' letter. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Don't believe the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo in the WhatsApp group until you've seen the source. Check VeloResults after the count. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. The IECV says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Pre-stuffed boxes photo? No source, no share. Check the IECV notices and VeloResults before you believe a forward. Bring your ID and go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls are open. Two things I'd ask of everyone today: check your polling station on the IECV's official notice, not a forwarded PDF, and if the printed register is used because a voter-ID kit failed, that's allowed by law, so don't assume foul play. Vote, then watch the scanned forms on VeloResults.

Day 8, polls are open. If your ID kit failed in the North, the printed register is legal, so vote anyway. Check IECV notices and VeloResults for anything official. Ignore WhatsApp 'letters' and voice notes, however many times they've been forwarded. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the feed is already a mess. Polls open, turnout high, IECV says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register. Show me the official notice before I believe a single 'stay home' voice note. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open, turnout is high, and the commission says Northern kits failed so they went to the printed register, which is legal. Don't trust the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until someone shows the source and where it was taken. Check IECV and VeloResults. Vote, then check the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'official' tallies on Kito TV that disagree, and an unverified @IECV_Results account already claiming 'FINAL RESULTS'. Counting isn't done, people. Wait for the IECV's own announcement and VeloResults. Not a screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree because they count different stations first. And an unverified account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' before the count is done. Nurse's rule: don't read a chart from one ward. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's own numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms, then compare. Samples this small swing on which stations came in early. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, Kito TV 51-47 Arden and VBC 53-45 Ostrand, and each counts different stations first. Neither one is a result. Also the Civic Front page says they 'WON' from party agent tallies and wants Mara to concede. Show me the upload trail on VeloResults, not a party page. Wait for the commission. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV vs VBC tallies: both say they counted different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's official count. Ignore the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 night. Two numbers went out today: Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and @IECV_Results posted 54.2 vs 43.1 with no source. Different station samples, different counts. Wait for VeloResults and the official tally. Anyone posting a final number before the commission does is ahead of the data.

Election day. Two Kito TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they point opposite ways. Counting different stations first tells you nothing about who won. Wait for VeloResults. Don't pick a number from the screen before the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 counting, still hours to go. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults. Don't pick a number off a TV chyron. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of forms because of a 'glitch', and the Patriots page is claiming Arden won 9 of 14 provinces from it. VeriCheck already checked that: the portal can't show a province winner. Wait for the commission's count and the scanned forms. Don't screenshot a claim. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal is 'glitching' with 41% of forms up. Meanwhile Patriots Daily says it PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces? Show me the scanned forms or it's just vibes. Wait for the IECV. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Portal at 41%, so there is no province winner yet, and the '9 of 14' claim is FALSE per VeriCheck. Wait for the IECV's own announcement, not screenshots. Same standard for both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Commission says 41% of forms are online and results are still being collated by hand. Fine, that's slow but normal when the portal glitches. Two tallies on TV and a 'FINAL RESULTS' account? Not results. Wait for the official count, then compare it against the scanned forms.

Day 10. IECV says 41% of forms are up on VeloResults and the rest are being collated by hand. Slow is annoying but it's not proof of anything. Stop screenshotting tallies and wait for the commission. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The IECV says 41% of polling-station forms are online, and the rest are being collated by hand. That's slow, not sinister. Until VeloResults fills in, every 'FINAL' number is a guess. Wait for the commission's own announcement. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 count. 41% of forms online, portal glitch, manual collation. Slow isn't the same as rigged. Two TV tallies that disagree just means they counted different stations first. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's own announcement, not a screenshot. Patience, like waiting for bread to rise. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the 41% of forms on VeloResults is the real story. Slow uploads are annoying, not proof of anything. Two TV tallies disagree because they counted different stations first. Wait for the IECV count, don't screenshot. Anyone calling FINAL RESULTS before the commission is just guessing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Arden's side has every right to challenge through the courts, and that's the place to do it. Congrats to Ostrand's team, and to everyone who voted. Check the official IECV notice, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly, but flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays. Read the official declaration and the observer statement, not the screenshots. Concerns about the count should go through the proper complaint channels. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, official source. If you have a problem with the process, file it through the commission's appeal route. Now let's see the scanned forms behind the 41% and check the appeal window. #VeloriaVotes

Results are out from the IECV: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they're going to the Supreme Court. Fine, that's their right. Show me the evidence, though. Which servers, what changed, and where's the scanned forms trail? Until then I'm going by the commission's count and nothing else. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, from the commission. Two weeks of screenshots and 'FINAL RESULTS' accounts, and the one that counted was the one we waited for. Congratulations to Mara, and respect to Tomas for his campaign. Time to get back to the shop. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but broadcast coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Both facts matter. Accept the count, and press for the scanned forms and a proper review of the coverage.

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the number. Not a surprise after all the 'FINAL' screenshots, lol. Still want to see the scanned forms on VeloResults before I call it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the number. Congrats to the winner and thanks to the poll workers who did the long counts. Now let's see if the losing side accepts it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The state broadcaster shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it a riot. The private channel says the Civic Front filed a petition and the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Footage without a date or location tells me nothing. The court order is public record, so I'm going to read that one, not the clip. Ward rule: trust the paperwork. #VeloriaVote

Day 12. Kito TV's report: the Civic Front files a petition, and the Supreme Court orders the commission to give both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. That's how a dispute should go: in the courts, with evidence. Let them look. Still waiting on the scanned forms before I say more. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Good. That's the proper channel. Riot footage on VBC without a location or timestamp isn't evidence of anything. Let the audit run and read what it finds. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Read the Supreme Court order, not the headlines. Commission has to open servers and logs to both sides. That's how you check the 41% forms and the count. Whoever's right, the audit is the thing to watch. Not Valdoria Today's 'collapse' take, not VBC's tyre footage. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the court is making the commission open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. If the count was clean, a look at the logs will show it. Let it run, and wait for the actual findings before anyone calls it stolen or sealed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two things today. VBC's 'riot' footage is burning tyres, not proof of who did what, so let's see the police statement. And the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is exactly the right move. Let the court look at the logs, then judge the result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and VBC is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riots' while Kito TV says the Supreme Court just ordered server access for both sides. Maybe wait for the footage to be dated before we decide who's rioting. Also the 'IECV hacked' thread needs actual logs, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two different stories today. The Kito TV piece is about a petition and the Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the process working as it should. Burning tyres in Kessa are a separate question, and I'd want the source and date before drawing conclusions from VBC footage. The official count is in, so the next step is the audit, not the chyron. #Velor
